title: 71-year-old man found unwell at home
arrival: A 71-year-old man is brought in by his daughter, who found him unwell at home this morning.
keyCriterion: Red — Disability: any two of altered mental status, stiff neck, hypothermia or fever, headache
feedbackWhy: He has two of the listed findings together: altered mental status (he is confused) and hypothermia (temperature 35.2°C). Two together meet a red Disability criterion, so he should be moved to the high acuity area immediately.
reviewNote: CLINICIAN REVIEW REQUIRED: confirm that 35.2°C counts as hypothermia on this card (the Disability section gives no number; the vital signs section uses Temp <36°). Confirm AVPU A is right for a confused patient who answers questions. Every value is proposed.

design.intendedChallenge: Some red criteria need two findings together. Confusion alone would be yellow. Confusion together with a low temperature is red, and the second finding has to be found by checking.
design.expectedCommonError: triaging as yellow because confusion alone is a yellow criterion.

unresponsive.text: Awake. Opens his eyes and answers when spoken to.

airway_red.text: Speaks clearly. No stridor. No respiratory distress. No central cyanosis.

circulation_red.text: Pulse strong. Capillary refill 2 seconds. No bleeding.

disability_red.text: Confused. Does not know the day or where he is. No convulsions. No headache. No stiff neck.

other_red.text: Age 71. No chest or abdominal pain. No trauma, poisoning, threatened limb or snake bite. Not aggressive.

airway_yellow.text: No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No wheezing.

circulation_yellow.text: No vomiting or diarrhoea. No bleeding or fainting. Not pale. Drinks when offered a cup.

disability_yellow.text: Confused but calm. Not agitated. No weakness. No visual disturbance. No pain.

other_yellow.text: No rash, deformity, fracture or dislocation. No trauma. No known surgical diagnosis. Passing urine normally. No bite or needlestick exposure.
